name: Construction Safety (Canada)
description: A representative starter catalogue of construction health and safety controls, loosely aligned to CSA Z1000 management principles and to common Canadian provincial construction requirements. It was never a published standard: its control identifiers (CSA-OHS-1, CSA-TR-2, CSA-FP-1 and the rest) were invented for this catalogue, and no authority issues or recognises them — CSA Z1000 and its successor number their clauses 4.1, 4.2 and so on, and an Ontario duty is numbered by the section of the instrument that imposes it. Superseded and retained only so that an organisation which adopted it can still read its own history; nothing new should cite it.
scope: Construction employers, general contractors, and trades operating on Canadian job sites
supersedes: Nothing — this catalogue had no prior edition. It is itself superseded, and in two directions. For management-system content, by CSA Z45001:19, Occupational health and safety management systems — Requirements with guidance for use (the Canadian adoption of ISO 45001:2018), which replaced CSA Z1000-14. For anything legally binding in Ontario, by the instruments that actually impose the duty: the Occupational Health and Safety Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. O.1, and the regulations made under it — O. Reg. 213/91 (Construction Projects), O. Reg. 297/13 (Occupational Health and Safety Awareness and Training), O. Reg. 632/05 (Confined Spaces), O. Reg. 278/05 (Designated Substance — Asbestos), O. Reg. 559/22 (Naloxone Kits) and R.R.O. 1990, Reg. 860 (WHMIS) — together with the Workplace Safety and Insurance Act, 1997, S.O. 1997, c. 16, Sched. A and R.R.O. 1990, Reg. 1101 (First Aid Requirements).
changes_summary: Retired 2026-09-22. Its description always called it a "representative starter catalog"; what made retirement necessary is that it was being CITED as though it were not one. Eighteen citations in the Ontario construction programme pointed at control identifiers no auditor could look up, while that programme's own prose cited O. Reg. 213/91 thirteen times with nowhere to cite it. Those citations now name the sections of the instruments themselves. A superseded standard is never deleted: evidence was gathered against it, and an audit of a past period is judged against what applied then.

families.name: OHS Management System
families.description: Governance of the health & safety program (aligned with CSA Z1000).

controls.name: Health & Safety Policy
controls.description: A documented, signed occupational health & safety policy is established, communicated, and reviewed.

controls.name: Hazard Identification & Risk Assessment
controls.description: Workplace hazards are systematically identified and assessed, with controls applied per the hierarchy of controls.

controls.name: Joint Health & Safety Committee
controls.description: A functioning joint health & safety committee or safety representative is in place as required by jurisdiction and workforce size.

families.name: Training & Competency
families.description: Worker orientation, training, and competency verification.

controls.name: Site Orientation & Safety Training
controls.description: All workers receive site-specific safety orientation and role-appropriate training before starting work.

controls.name: WHMIS / Hazardous Materials
controls.description: Workers are trained on WHMIS 2015; SDS are accessible and hazardous products are labelled and stored correctly.

families.name: Fall Protection
families.description: Protection from falls, a leading cause of construction fatalities.

controls.name: Fall Protection Program
controls.description: A fall protection plan is in place for work at heights above the regulated threshold, with appropriate systems (guardrails, travel restraint, fall arrest).

controls.name: Equipment Inspection
controls.description: Fall protection equipment is inspected before use and on a documented schedule; defective equipment is removed from service.

families.name: Personal Protective Equipment
families.description: Provision, use, and maintenance of PPE.

controls.name: PPE Provision & Use
controls.description: Required PPE (head, eye, foot, hearing, high-visibility, respiratory) is provided, worn, and maintained appropriate to the hazard.

families.name: Site Hazard Controls
families.description: High-risk construction activities with prescriptive controls.

controls.name: Excavation & Trenching
controls.description: Excavations are protected against collapse (shoring, sloping, or trench boxes) and inspected by a competent person.

controls.name: Equipment & Machinery Safety
controls.description: Powered equipment and machinery are inspected, guarded, and operated only by trained/certified personnel; lockout-tagout applies to servicing.

controls.name: Incident Reporting & Investigation
controls.description: Injuries, near-misses, and critical incidents are reported, investigated, and reported to the regulator as required; corrective actions are tracked.
